frames.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Production raster garden-walk animation frame of Paco the floppy-eared dog, facing RIGHT in clear profile, a calm cheerful children's-book walk. Reference 1 is Paco's canonical identity: cream fur, orange-brown floppy ears, pale blue and cream striped sailor shirt, mint neckerchief, black soft outline. Reference 2 is Paco's watering sheet: match exact colours, body proportions, character apparent size and position in a 627x627 cell; ignore front facing direction and pouring. Reference 3 is Miffy's approved v2 pose for this phase: match phase, upright watering-can placement, broad stride, framing and baseline, translate rabbit identity into Paco. One full-body dog only on uniform flat #00ff00 chroma green background (opaque). No scene, no grass, no shadow, no text. Upright blue watering can in bent FRONT carrying paw, spout right, never pouring, no water or droplets. Free arm swings opposite advancing leg. Keep shirt stripes and scarf consistent, complete feet and tail. In 627 equivalent coordinates character body centre x330, grounded soles y568, top of head about y135; keep generous green margin. Dog profile should show one eye and black nose projecting right, one dominant orange floppy ear on near side and small far ear; small cream tail behind. Keep short dog legs but show substantial stride. Output one square frame, not a grid.
PHASE: W1 CONTACT RIGHT FOOT: near/right leg forward toward right, heel on ground, toes up slightly; far/left leg stretched behind to left, toes touch ground, heel lifted. Lowest body point. Free arm swings backward. Clearly separated feet, broad stride.
